summary:
Implementation plan for VIP key activation lifecycle and user schema synchronization:
- Admin VIP keys begin their 30-day validity upon user activation rather than generation date.
- User profile documents in Firestore will strictly adhere to the requested schema with vip, vipkey, expire, vipExpiresAt, plan, and updatedAt.
- On user login, the web app will auto-initialize or sync this exact schema and validate expiration.
